items.why: The plan cards were rewritten with longer copy and the AI allowances (already in the comparison table) moved onto them; the only new number is a $5.99 per user on-demand price that appears in one of two page versions served in the same run.
The Prevent price changed from $0.1 to $0.10 per scanned transaction, which is a formatting difference with the same value.
The Pro button text changed from “Get started for free” to “Try for $0.00”; no price or trial terms changed.
The pricing FAQ now says WhatsApp is charged per message sent instead of per conversation, a change of billing unit.

record.short: WhatsApp usage billing changes from per conversation to per message sent.
record.headline: Intercom’s pricing FAQ now says WhatsApp is charged for each message sent, where it used to say each conversation.
rows: Charged per message sent (varies by market/message type)
record.who: Customers using WhatsApp on Intercom; the FAQ does not say whether existing customers move over or when.
record.read: Per-message billing makes cost scale with how chatty a thread is rather than with the number of threads. This looks like Intercom following the way WhatsApp itself now charges, but that is our inference.
record.caveat: The page also showed two versions in this run; both carry the new WhatsApp wording, and no WhatsApp rates are published on the page.

items.why: The Basic (free) plan’s in-meeting questions allowance rose from 3 to 20 in the comparison table.

record.short: Zoom Basic’s in-meeting questions allowance rises from 3 to 20.
record.headline: Zoom’s free Basic plan now allows 20 in-meeting questions instead of 3, while meeting summaries stay at 3.
record.who: Users on the free Basic plan; paid plans already show Unlimited.
record.read: A bigger free allowance for the AI questions feature gives free users more of a taste of the paid AI tier. Summaries and AI note-taking were left at 3, so the paywall has moved only on one feature.
record.caveat: The page showed two versions in this run, and both carry the new value. The page is displayed in CA$ for this visitor; no prices changed.
